newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras started as buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said on Tuesday it had started coverage of Brazilian state telecommunications company Telebras SA with a buy rating.
-- Analyst Patrick Jurczak said in a report he set a target price of $110 to $120 per American Depositary Receipt within a year.

-- "The cheapest stock among the Latin American telecom stocks covered by ING Barings, Telebras is priced at $75.75 and is trading at a price/earnings ratio of only seven times 1997 estimated earnings, 2.5 times 1997 estimated EBITDA and only 90 percent of its book value," he said.
